ownership: Per-import container, partial meshes/materials/textures and accessor/view data only; no scene-wide pending clear.
Sequential owned texture wrapper release marks and removes only the final InternalTexture owner; external shared owners retain pending/cache/upload rights.
Marked final-owner texture is synchronously removed from exact engine cache entry before disposal; SDK late _createTexture throws AbortError before bind/upload.
Every abandoned promise retains fulfillment/rejection handling, but model owner release settles immediately.
Late source/ground/resource callbacks use map, floor, scene, lifetime and generation identities before publication.
Immutable shared manifest entries own their own deadline; caller cancellation does not abort another caller. Failed entries and initialization promises reset only if still current.
limitations: No browser automation, actual WebGL GPU execution, phone FPS, temperature, or driver timing was measured.
Actual shipped Meshopt buffers and real WASM decoding are exercised with a controlled response boundary. Image upload/late KTX guards use the installed SDK and a stub engine sink.
The logical timeout cannot preempt synchronous JavaScript/WASM/driver execution. Timers run when the event loop can run.
The Babylon global worker is not terminated/restarted. A persistent worker fault can make explicit retry time out again.
A permanently unanswered worker may retain detached CPU input and promise data until it returns; cleanup does not claim forced physical memory reclamation.
Normal shared texture SDK callbacks may still run; abandoned map-owner publication is guarded, rather than claiming that every raw callback is suppressed.
finalFix: Same-floor manual retry reuses registered ground detail and shade plugins instead of accumulating active duplicate plugins referencing disposed textures.
